newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan aluminium output, shipments rise in November.
newsitem.headline: Japan aluminium output, shipments rise in November.

text.p: Japanese output and shipments of fabricated aluminium products rose in November from the same period last year, the Japan Aluminum Federation said on Wednesday.
The November data was as follows (in tonnes):
The federation said November was the sixth consecutive month output had increased on a year-on-year basis and the eighth month of higher shipments.

The revised October shipments data showed strong gains in the automotive and construction sectors, which rose year-on-year by 28.3 percent to 17,866 tonnes and 9.8 percent to 89,886 tonnes, respectively.

Industry officials have noted that demand from the housing construction sector has been brisk in recent months, as consumers rush to purchase homes ahead of next April's scheduled hike in the consumption tax.
